author_traits.effect_hypothesis: Concrete physical objects, bodily states, and work carry moral/theological abstraction without requiring purely expository explanation.
quantitative_support: persistent concrete/body lexicon across all seven books

author_traits.effect_hypothesis: Characters are allowed to inhabit competing moral truths without cheap resolution.
Compressed contrast can sharpen meaning and memorability.
failure_modes: reader is told the interpretation after already receiving it
author_traits.local_overuse_trigger: elevated local density of not/but, reversal, or interpretive capstone constructions
quantitative_support: not_but_per_10k varies materially across books and declines across Unhindered sequence

author_traits.effect_hypothesis: Hands, tools, labor, and material craft externalize character formation and consequence.
failure_modes: same embodiment channel crowds out alternatives
quantitative_support: hand and concrete-motif densities are high in earlier books but fall across Unhindered sequence

author_traits.effect_hypothesis: Brief dry humor releases pressure while preserving character dignity and period register.
failure_modes: joke competes with grief or sacred weight

MOSES.effect_hypothesis: Elevated imagery and sensory saturation create prophetic/theological scale.
Dust, water, fire, stone, wilderness, and physical geography carry covenantal/theological structure.

UNHINDERED.effect_hypothesis: Theology, ethics, institutional pressure, and character change are increasingly carried by contested dialogue rather than narrator verdict.
Money, law, travel, labor, custody, rumor, household obligation, and communal procedure make theological conflict materially consequential.
Explicit interpretive afterbeats can clarify but may weaken scenes when dialogue/action has already landed the meaning.
UNHINDERED.trajectory_support: declining not/but and simile markers alongside rising dialogue density

observed_direction_candidates: dialogue carries a larger share of scene meaning
explicit not/but antithesis becomes less frequent
as-if/like comparison markers become less frequent
hands/body/concrete motif density becomes less dominant

suppression_policy.reason: No trait is assigned SUPPRESS from recurrence/statistics alone; stronger causal evidence is required.
